messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty PD-87922 fired for synthetic-check 'canary-main-eu1' — 77% failures in last 3m. Probe group: canary-main, region=eu1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-87922 — runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SRE/pages/canary-runbook

pagerduty: PD-87922 auto-escalated to on-call: @jamal (SRE) — severity: P2 — notify: sms/email/push

jamal: ack — I'm taking this. Looking at the probe dashboard now. :mag: Anyone seeing related customer errors?

mira: seeing a small bump in 502/503s from eu1 on the edge dashboard that lines up with the probe failures. Not seeing inbound customer tickets yet. Grafana: https://grafana.example/d/edge/eu1?from=now-30m to=now

tilly: good call. If this is noisy paging we should throttle the prober fanout while we triage. Jamal — runbook step 1: check prober pod logs + probe host health.

jamal: running checks now. Command I'm using:
```
kubectl -n probes logs deploy/canary-runner-eu1 -c prober --tail=300 | egrep "ERROR|timeout|reset|5.."
```
Getting repeated lines like:
```
2026-06-02T12:14:05Z error http request failed: read tcp 10.12.5.33:52344->54.23.11.9:443: read: connection reset by peer
2026-06-02T12:14:07Z warn probe timeout: 8.2s (threshold 5s)
2026-06-02T12:14:08Z error upstream 502 from backend pool eu1-origin-02
```

jamal: looks like network resets + occasional 502s from origin. To stop noisy pager churn I'm going to temporarily reduce probe fanout and suppress further PD pages for this alert while we triage.

mira: 👍 please put a note in the thread when you disable. Also checking customer-facing metrics (edge errors, app errors).

jamal: disabled extra fanout and limited canary to single-runner (command):
```
/opt/prober/proberctl set-concurrency --target canary-main-eu1 --concurrency 1 --reason "noise-mitigation"
/opt/prober/proberctl suppress-alert --alert PD-87922 --window 5m
```
incident-bot: Command accepted — probe concurrency set to 1, alert suppression active for 5m.

mira: after limiting fanout probes dropped but backend 502s persist at a low level. Edge 5xx rate down from 2.1% -> 0.9% since mitigation started. Still above baseline (~0.2%).

tilly: check recent deploys — any routing or canary changes around 12:20 UTC? I see a canary rollout in the routing service changelog at 12:18. If we roll that back it might clear origin errors.

jamal: pulling rollout history: `kubectl -n routing rollout history deploy/routing-service` — last canary at 2026-06-02T12:18 by user: deploy-bot (sha: ab12c3). I'm going to roll back the canary to the previous stable:
```
kubectl -n routing rollout undo deploy/routing-service --to-revision=42
```
Rolling back now.

mira: monitoring after rollback — edge 5xx reduced to 0.25% and synthetic probes starting to succeed. Looks like routing change introduced a bad upstream target.

pagerduty: PD-87922 acknowledged by jamal at 1799991155. Auto-notify suppressed.

jamal: rollback complete at 1799991200. Confirming canary probes now hitting healthy origin. Sample probe run: `200 OK`  latency ~80ms.

mira: customer impact summary: minor — ~2% of EU traffic saw increased 5xx for ~18 minutes (12:14-12:32 UTC). No direct customer-reported incidents. Root cause initial hypothesis: bad canary routing config that sent traffic to an unhealthy origin pool + prober fanout amplified symptom noise.

tilly: good containment. Next actions: 1) tighten prober fanout defaults for canaries (reduce max concurrency + add exponential backoff), 2) add a circuit-breaker in routing-service to avoid sending traffic to failing origin pools, 3) improve runbook step to include immediate routing rollback when origin 5xx > 1% for 5m. Jamal — can you file the follow-up ticket?

jamal: filing INC-2026-089 and assigning the rollout changeowner + routing team. Will add timings, logs, and commands used.

mira: I'll own the postmortem write-up (links + customer impact). Will ping product for any customer communication if needed.

tilly: handing off to SRE postmortem owner @mira. Marking incident resolved in the channel once PD cleared. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PD-87922 resolved (status: closed) at 1799991499 — automatic resolution: alert suppressed then recovered and underlying rollback restored healthy responses.

jamal: closing thread — will post the postmortem link when ready. Thanks all for quick coordination. :thumbsup:
